Offer accepted in Georgetown? Do these 5 things first. 1) Deliver your deposit on time; the deadline is in your agreement. 2) Note every condition date: financing, inspection and any others. 3) Send your accepted offer to your mortgage lender right away. 4) Book your home inspection early if it is a condition. 5) Give the agreement to your real estate lawyer to start the closing process.

Send this to someone whose offer was just accepted. General information only, not legal, tax or mortgage advice.

FHSA: save up to $8,000 a year toward your first home. The First Home Savings Account lets eligible first-time buyers contribute up to $8,000 a year, to a lifetime limit of $40,000. Contributions are tax-deductible, and qualifying withdrawals for a first home are tax-free. Unused room carries forward (up to $8,000). (Source: Canada Revenue Agency, First Home Savings Account, accessed Oct 2026.)

Eligibility rules apply. Not tax, mortgage or legal advice; speak with your financial institution or tax professional.

No, a mortgage pre-approval isn't a final approval. 1) A pre-approval is the lender's estimate, based on what you told them. 2) The rate is usually held for a limited time; ask how long. 3) The lender still reviews the home you choose before final approval. 4) They may also recheck your income, debts and credit before closing. 5) Talk to your lender before changing jobs or taking on new debt.

Save this before you start house hunting in Brampton. General information only, not legal, tax or mortgage advice. Terms vary by lender.
